metadata.scope: Ship std/regex backed by Go regexp (RE2, linear-time): two-stage compile -> Result[Regex,string] + total match fns (isMatch, findFirst, findAll, replaceAll, split) with capture groups. Purely additive: new internal/eval/builtins_regex.go, new _regex_* builtin names, new std/regex module. NON-SCOPE: backreferences/lookaround (inherent RE2 limitation, compile returns Err), replaceAllFunc (AILANG-callback repl, deferred), named-group map accessor (deferred), compiled-handle int registry (deferred unless string-cache proven insufficient), URL parse (queue #12). Closes v1.0 bar clause 4 regex half.
metadata.estimated_effort: 2 days (M1 1d engine+builtins+unit tests, M2 0.5d stdlib module+examples, M3 0.5d integration tests+docs+buffer)
metadata.verification_binary: read-only against HEAD v0.29.2-35-gb62ab5433 (make quick-install; ailang --version == git describe); sources read live, no code written by planner
metadata.gpu_step: NONE - pure Go builtin + AILANG stdlib + cloud-model evaluation; does not touch ollama/local models, no rig.lock needed

velocity.loc_note: 750 = M1 ~400 (impl ~220 + tests ~180) + M2 ~170 (module ~70 + examples ~90 + website reg) + M3 ~180 (integration test + docs). Test-heavy; the 2-day budget is gated by the byte->rune offset correctness (F1), not typing volume. The RE2-wrap decision keeps this at 2d not multi-week.

discrepancies_found.doc_claim: Risks table: 'Byte-offset vs rune-index mismatch between Go regexp (byte offsets) and AILANG string indexing' flagged Medium, convention to be determined.
discrepancies_found.finding: CONFIRMED REAL + resolved: _str_slice and _str_len are rune-indexed / UTF-8 aware (internal/eval/builtins_string.go:77 '_str_len returns number of runes not bytes', :88 '_str_slice with UTF-8 rune indices'). Go regexp FindStringSubmatchIndex returns BYTE offsets.
discrepancies_found.action: M1 MUST convert byte offsets -> rune indices for the exposed RegexMatch.start/end and groups[].start/end so spans match std/string. Slice .text from the byte offsets (correct regardless). Multibyte-UTF8 test fixture is a required M1 acceptance criterion.

discrepancies_found.action: std/regex.ail auto-embeds by existing in std/. Do NOT modify std/embed.go.

risks: Byte<->rune offset mismatch (F1) - mitigated by M1 headline requirement + multibyte fixture
Nested record/list marshalling into eval.Value is fiddly - mitigated by copying builtins_json.go (records) + builtins_string.go (_str_split list) patterns verbatim
Users expect PCRE backref/lookaround, hit Err - mitigated by loud compile error + LIMITATIONS note + example framing RE2 tradeoff as safety
Hidden compile-cache nondeterminism/leak - mitigated by pure memoization keyed by pattern string, mutex-guarded, compile-twice test

features.description: Create internal/eval/builtins_regex.go: six _regex_* builtins (_regex_compile, _regex_is_match, _regex_find_first, _regex_find_all, _regex_replace_all, _regex_split) delegating to a mutex-guarded memoized *regexp.Regexp cache keyed by pattern string. Marshal Result/record/list results with the SAME helpers builtins_json.go and builtins_string.go use. Convert byte offsets -> rune indices for exposed spans (F1); slice .text from byte offsets; non-participating optional groups report start=-1. Register via registerRegexBuiltins() in builtins.go init() (F3), all IsPure:true. Go unit tests incl. linear-time wall bound + multibyte rune fixture + compile-err-no-panic + cache memoization.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./internal/eval/... -run Regex -count=1 green
_regex_compile returns Err (never panics) for '(' (unbalanced), '(?=x)' (lookaround), '(a)\1' (backref)
Linear-time bound test: (a+)+$ vs strings.Repeat("a",40)+"!" completes under a hard wall bound (e.g. 100ms)
Multibyte-UTF8 fixture: RegexMatch spans are rune indices consistent with _str_slice/_str_len, NOT byte offsets (F1)
findFirst/findAll return correct spans+text for a multi-group pattern; non-participating optional group reports start=-1
replaceAll with $1 works; split on \s+ works
Compile-twice-same-pattern returns consistent result (cache memoization test)
>=80% coverage on builtins_regex.go; make lint clean on the new file
registerRegexBuiltins() added to builtins.go init(); builtin-registry test confirms all prior builtins still present
features.notes: internal/builtins/regex.go — 6 _regex_* builtins via modern RegisterEffectBuiltin (NOT eval/builtins_json.go path the doc referenced — D-ARCH), mutex-guarded memoized regexp cache, byte->rune span conversion (F1). Tests pass -count=20: compile Err-never-panics for ( / (?=x) / (a)\1; linear-time (a+)+$<100ms; multibyte rune fixture; find/groups/split/replaceAll; cache memoization. Golden builtin_types regenerated. Coverage ~89.5%.

features.description: Create std/regex.ail (auto-embedded via //go:embed *.ail glob, F2 - do NOT touch embed.go): export type Regex = Regex(string), export type RegexMatch record, and six pure func wrappers per the design doc Public API (already ailang check-verified). Add examples/regex_basics.ail (isMatch/find/split), examples/regex_capture.ail (group extraction), and one orchestration-flavored example (validate + extract fields from a log/LLM line, feeds clause-4 flagship #19). Register examples on the website via raw-loader per coding-standards.
